stories.title: Joshua Báez Historic MLB Debut — Game 2 Recap
stories.angle: Joshua Báez, called up from Memphis the morning of Aug 15, became the first player in MLB history to homer in his first three career at-bats — 449 ft, 382 ft, 368 ft — with 30 family members in the Wrigley stands. Cardinals won Game 2 as a result. Lead with the history, not the score (has_score=False insight). Acknowledge it happened at our house.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Joshua Báez just made MLB history at Wrigley Field.

Three HRs in his first three big-league at-bats — a feat no player had ever pulled off. 449 feet, 382 feet, 368 feet. The Cardinals walked into our house and introduced a legend.

A rough one. He earned it.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

research.facts:
Joshua Báez Historic MLB Debut (Game 2 Recap)
**Angle:** NEW STORY — Cardinals 8, Cubs 4. Báez becomes first player in MLB history to homer in his first three at-bats.
**Key Facts:**
- Joshua Báez called up from Triple-A Memphis on Aug 15
- 30 family members in attendance at Wrigley Field
- First at-bat: Two-run HR, 449 feet to dead center field (first pitch he saw in the majors)
- Second at-bat: Solo HR, 382 feet to left field (4th inning; put Cardinals ahead 4-3)
- Third at-bat: HR, 368 feet to right field (6th inning)
- Total: 3 HR, 5 RBI in MLB debut
- First in MLB history: No player had ever homered in their first three career at-bats

stories.title: Cardinals Wild Card Reality Check — Báez Debut Can't Mask the Record
stories.angle: Báez's debut was historic. Credit given. But the Cardinals sold at the deadline (Dustin May, JoJo Romero to Brewers on Aug 3), sit at 62-61, and need to make up 3 games on the D-backs just to reach a Wild Card spot. Báez is a building block, not an October ticket.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Joshua Báez's debut was genuinely special. Props.

But this is a Cardinals team that sold at the deadline, sits at 62-61, and needs help just to reach the Wild Card.

Báez gives them something to build toward. Not this October.

#Cubs #MLB #NorthSiders

research.facts:
Rotation Depth — Why Cabrera Matters for September
**Angle:** NEW STORY — Connect Cabrera's return to the bigger picture of a decimated Cubs rotation.
**Key Facts:**
- Cade Horton: Tommy John surgery — out for season
- Jordan Wicks (referenced as "Miller" in some injury reports — cross-reference needed): Tommy John surgery — out for season
- Harvey: 60-day IL (triceps inflammation); threw bullpen in Arizona Aug 15
- Phil Maton: PRP injection, 3-week rest period (placed July 21 — returns ~Aug 11 window, not yet active)
- Daniel Palencia: Right elbow inflammation, beginning rehab assignment
- Jackson Hodge: UCL surgery — out for season
- Cabrera's 9 scoreless rehab innings = ready signal
- With holes in rotation, Cabrera fills a critical slot through September
**Sources:**
